newsitem.title: DUBAI: Oman stocks rise 1.5pct in active week's trade.
newsitem.headline: Oman stocks rise 1.5pct in active week's trade.

text.p: Shares on the Oman stock exchange rose 1.5 percent in the week to Wednesday with banks and financial stocks leading trade.
The Muscat Securities Market said the index climbed to 276.85 points from 272.73 points the previous week.
The total value of trade was up at 17.52 million rials ($46 million) from 12.12 million rials the week earlier. Some 5.74 million shares were traded, up from 4.14 million shares.
The exchange said banking and financial shares dominated the market, accounting for 76 percent of trade, followed by services with 12 percent, industrials 10 percent and insurance two percent.

Commercial Bank of Oman was among the week's most active stocks, with 773,000 shares worth 2.45 million rials changing hands. The stock gained, closing at 2.740 rials from 2.730 the previous close. Bank Muscat Al Ahli Al Omani closed at 5.250 rials from 5.100 the previous week.
Dhofar International Development and Investment Co extended recent gains, climbing to 2.960 from 2.830 last week.
Al-Ahlia Portfolio closed up at 7.750 from 7.650.
Of the 73 shares traded in the week, 38 rose, 10 dipped and 25 were unchanged.
